event BytecodeSent(uint256 _chainId, tuple(bytes32 contractType, tuple(tuple(uint64 major, uint64 minor, uint64 patch) version, string alternative) version) _bytecodeVersion)
event ChainConfigSet(uint256 _chainId, tuple(address l2DeployManager, uint64 destinationChainSelector) _config)

event ContractDeployed(tuple(bytes32 contractType, tuple(tuple(uint64 major, uint64 minor, uint64 patch) version, string alternative) version) _bytecodeVersion, bytes _constructorParams, address _newContract, address _deployer)
function chainConfigs(uint256) view returns (address l2DeployManager, uint64 destinationChainSelector)

function computeAddress(tuple(bytes32 contractType, tuple(tuple(uint64 major, uint64 minor, uint64 patch) version, string alternative) version) _bytecodeVersion, bytes32 _salt, bytes _constructorParams, address _deployer) view returns (address)

function deploy(tuple(bytes32 contractType, tuple(tuple(uint64 major, uint64 minor, uint64 patch) version, string alternative) version) _bytecodeVersion, bytes32 _salt, bytes _constructorParams) payable returns (address)

function sendBytecodeToOtherChain(tuple(bytes32 contractType, tuple(tuple(uint64 major, uint64 minor, uint64 patch) version, string alternative) version) _bytecodeVersion, uint256 _chainId, uint256 _gasLimit) payable
function setChainConfig(uint256 _chainId, tuple(address l2DeployManager, uint64 destinationChainSelector) _config)
function upgradeToAndCall(address newImplementation, bytes data) payable
